description_en: Kulle Koṭa is located to the south-east of Devala Hāṭa (see BTD0030 and BTD0040), between Dehīmāṇḍau in the south-east and Goṭhalāpānī in the north-west.The hill contains a few archaeological artefacts that attest the occupation of the site around the 14th-15th century. D. R. Sharma reports that the place is locally considered to contain "a former palace of Garbha Chanda, a ruler of late medieval period" (Sharma 2012: 284). Garbha Chanda is not know from the consulted historical sources. The name is nevertheless similar to that of the donor mentioned in an undated inscription and found nearby, in Devala Hāṭa (BTD0030-013). The person mentioned in this inscription is Garbha Deva (seeSharma 2012: 349).The most notable remains at the site are a large stone lintel with a central image of Gaṇeśa, and two stone images, one of Viṣṇu, the other of an unidentified goddess. The artefacts can be roughly dated from the 13th-15th century. Interestingly, the latter sculptures are executed in a bluish stone recalling the one used for the Varāha image kept in Tripurasundarī (BTD0060). Furthermore, the image of Gaṇeśa in the lintel and the shape of the niche are similar to those observed on the lintel of aśikharatemple in Devala Hāṭa (BTD0030-003). This could indicate the presence of aśikharatemple on the site.Their dimensions are as follow:- BTD0050-001 (lintel): 22 x 167 x 35 cm- BTD0050-002 (stone Viṣṇu): 35 x 22 x 8 cm- BTD0050-003 (stone goddess): 28 x 12 x 7 cm
description_ne: देवल हाटको (हेर्नुहोस् BTD0030 and BTD0040) दक्षिण-पूर्व दिशातर्फ कुल्ले कोट अवस्थित छ । यो सानो थुम्कोमा अवस्थित कोटमा ईशाको चौधौं या पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीतिरका पुरातात्विक वस्तुहरू छन् । डिल्लीराज शर्माले भने अनुसार यो उत्तर मल्लकालका शासक गर्भ चन्दको दरवारको भग्नावशेष हो (हेर्नुहोस्Sharma 2012: 284) । तर गर्भ चन्दको बारेमा कुनै पनि प्रामाणिक ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज भेटिएको छैन । देवल हाटको एउटा मिति उल्लेख नगरिएको अभिलेखमा गर्भ देव भन्ने नाम छ (हेर्नुहोस्Sharma 2012: 349) र यीनै गर्भ देव नै गर्भ चन्द हुन पनि सक्ने अनुमान भने गर्न सकिन्छ । यो भग्नावशेषभित्र सजिलै देख्न सकिने वस्तुहरू भनेका एउटा ढुङ्गाको थाम जसको मध्य भागमा गणेशको चित्र कुँदिएको छ, एउटा विष्णुको प्रस्तर मूर्ति र अर्को एउटा कसको हो भनेर छुट्याउने नसकिने प्रस्तरकै मूर्ति हुन् । यी वस्तुहरू ईशाको तेह्रौंदेखि पन्ध्रौं शताब्दीभित्रका हुन सक्ने अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ । यी दुई मूर्तिहरू र त्रिपुरासुन्दरीमा भएको वराहाको मूर्ति (BTD0060) निलो निलो रङ्गका देखिन्छन् । त्यसैगरी माथि उल्लिखित ढुङ्गाको थाममा कुँदिएका गणेशको आकृति र खोपाहरू चाँहि देवल हाट (BTD0030-003) को शिखर मन्दिरको थाममा कुँदिएका आकृतिहरूसंग मेल खान्छन् ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths), Structural damages
references: REFERENCES Sharma, Dilli Raj. 2012. Heritage of Western Nepal. Art and Architecture . Kathmandu: Centre for Nepal and Asian Studies.
